verdict.rationale: This is a fair axis for a game engine, since some engines ship as importable packages, so the story applies to Unreal. However, nothing in the pack shows Unreal installing from a package registry as an importable, bundleable, tree-shakeable library. The evidence describes an editor-centric workflow: C++ compiled with Visual Studio or Xcode, plus cooking and packaging through the Unreal Editor and Unreal Automation Tool. Source access is gated behind an account and EULA rather than a public package registry.
